known_secrets.text: Multiple town systems — the Great Bath, the granaries, the Assembly's records — were simultaneously reorganized after the Turning.
Specific individuals, including herself, were deliberately removed from civic tally-rolls.
Some removed records correspond to physical infrastructure that still exists, including a Citadel wing no longer matching the current structure.
This implies an intentional disconnection between memory and the physical town, not accidental record loss.
Partial mappings of the pre-Turning town layout are still in her possession.
These mappings suggest additional, older access routes near the Citadel that are no longer in official use.
These maps have never been shared with any active Assembly authority.
She holds no trust in the Assembly's centralized version of the town's past.
